fusions.name: Thumb-Edge Nick
fusions.desc: A quick nick that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and has a 25% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeve Blade
fusions.desc: Draws a blade from your sleeve and buries it for 18 damage, leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Always Within Reach
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Clean Draw
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
